cards.name: CentriKid Camp
cards.description: Campers participate in Bible study, worship, recreation and activity tracks at an overnight camp for church groups.
cards.review_notes: The 2026 dates and university venue were readable only in official search results. The street address is printed on the church's 2025 CentriKid event page. Confirm the church group's actual drop-off location; the 2026 page lists the university but does not explain church departure arrangements. Completed grades 2–6 come from the camp operator's general FAQ, not the church's 2026 event listing. Event endpoint times of 13:00 and 14:00 are not daily camp hours.
